description: Compare live read-only Base swap quotes from 1inch and KyberSwap, evaluating output, fees/gas, price impact, consensus and divergence to return EXECUTE_BEST, WAIT or INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Quotes reflect current market state, may vary between calls, and may be partial on provider failure. USE WHEN: comparing Base swap routes to decide execution, wait or data sufficiency. DO NOT USE WHEN: executing, submitting, signing or authorizing swaps or transactions.

amount_in.description: Positive decimal input amount, converted exactly to raw token units.
amount_in.title: Amount In

baseline_provider.description: Optional comparison reference provider; sets economic advantage baseline, does not change best provider selection.
baseline_provider.title: Baseline Provider

chain.description: Base Mainnet only in this quote-only MVP.
chain.title: Chain

slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points; sets minimum_output when provider omits it; not a cost.
slippage_bps.title: Slippage Bps

token_out.description: Output Base asset symbol; must differ from token_in.
token_out.title: Token Out

name: defi_route_decision

best_provider.description: Best comparable provider when ≥2 valid quotes exist, else null.

confidence.description: Deterministic comparison confidence; never HIGH with only 2 providers.

consensus.description: Comparable-output median and comparison basis when two provider quotes are valid.

decision.description: Deterministic economic decision (EXECUTE_BEST/WAIT/INSUFFICIENT_DATA); not a safety authorization, does not execute swaps.

decision_reason.description: Human-readable deterministic reason for the decision.

decision_signals.description: Objective signals used for the decision.

economic_advantage.description: Best quote versus declared baseline or next available quote; never ROI.

economics.description: Known or unknown estimated provider COGS; unknown is never represented as zero.

evidence_quality.description: Per-provider reported, calculated, estimated, or unavailable field quality.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the latest provider quote was observed during this request.

partial.description: True when any provider fails to return a valid quote.

provider_failures.description: Providers that failed to return a valid quote, with provider name and failure category.

category.description: Failure category for the provider quote failure.

provider.description: Name of the quote provider that failed.

quotes.description: Normalized provider quote evidence in raw token units.

status.description: Quote comparison outcome: COMPARISON_AVAILABLE (≥2 valid quotes), PARTIAL (some failed), UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE (none valid).

usage.description: Per-provider call success, latency, and configured cost-estimate availability.

title: DeFi Route Decision
